title: A Cipher for the Ledger
author: Ulyana Joubert
blurb: Ada Oyelaran, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has spent ten years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
